aspects.name: Iron Oath
aspects.description: Castle-forged plate and oathbound steel.

aspects.name: Cold Facet
aspects.description: Light caught in a stone that was never warm.

aspects.name: Umbral Void
aspects.description: What the chapel wore after the lamps went out.

aspects.name: Cathedral Gold
aspects.description: Gilt left on a thing nobody prays to now.

aspects.name: Ember Watch
aspects.description: The colour of the last fire anyone kept.

aspects.name: Swamp Warden
aspects.description: Bile-green and patient. Earned in the standing water.

aspects.name: Frozen Steel
aspects.description: Metal that keeps the cold long after the walk out.

aspects.name: Vault Iron
aspects.description: Dull, honest, and closed for a very long time.

aspects.name: Prism Light
aspects.description: A colour that is several colours, depending on the hour.

aspects.name: Mire Venom
aspects.description: Worn by those who came back up out of the mire.

aspects.name: Hollow Ice
aspects.description: Pale to the point of absence. It suits the place.

aspects.name: Ember Vigil
aspects.description: Banked low, kept all night, never quite out.

aspects.name: Verdant Creep
aspects.description: Green takes a ruin back slowly, then all at once.

aspects.name: Tidewater
aspects.description: The colour of a coast that keeps what it takes.

aspects.name: Orchid Wake
aspects.description: Flowers left too long on a stone with no name.

aspects.name: Rust Pilgrim
aspects.description: Armour that has walked further than it has fought.

aspects.name: Bronze Relict
aspects.description: Older than the castle. It was buried with someone.

aspects.name: Jade Censer
aspects.description: Smoke-stained green from a rite nobody finished.

aspects.name: Indigo Compact
aspects.description: Worn by those who agreed never to say what for.

aspects.name: Plum Mourning
aspects.description: Mourning dress, for a house that no longer counts.

aspects.name: Cinder March
aspects.description: Everything downwind of a fire looks like this.

aspects.name: Moss Quiet
aspects.description: What grows on a warden who stood still long enough.

aspects.name: Azure Lantern
aspects.description: The one light that does not gutter in the deep.

aspects.name: Amethyst Ward
aspects.description: Cut against dreaming. It did not work.

aspects.name: Saffron Herald
aspects.description: Loud enough to be seen coming. That is the point.

titles.name: the Oathkept
titles.description: Given to those who finished what the castle started.

titles.name: of the Cold Facet
titles.description: Spoken of anyone who walked out of the caverns.

titles.name: the Unabsolved
titles.description: The cathedral does not forgive; it only stops objecting.

titles.name: the Late Reader
titles.description: For those who kept reading after the lamp went low.
titles.unlockHint: Hear the whole of the Keeping.

titles.name: the Studied
titles.description: Earned by knowing every thing that lives down there.

titles.name: the Gate-Opener
titles.description: It was shut for a reason. You opened it anyway.

titles.name: the Lamplighter
titles.description: Relit what nobody was left to relight.

titles.name: the Unfinished
titles.description: Told the story to its end, and stayed anyway.
